overall_goal: Wash, slice, and cook the mushrooms in the frying pan

goals.rationale: The person rinses the mushrooms under the tap and shakes them dry before placing them on the chopping board.

goals.description: Slice the first batch of mushrooms
goals.rationale: The person begins cutting the stems off and slicing the first few mushrooms on the chopping board.

goals.description: Slice the remaining mushrooms and stems
goals.rationale: The person continues to chop the rest of the mushrooms and slices the larger stems to ensure even cooking.

goals.description: Transfer the sliced mushrooms to the frying pan
goals.rationale: The person picks up the chopping board and pushes the sliced mushrooms into the pan.

goals.description: Stir and cook the mushrooms in the pan
goals.rationale: The person adjusts the heat, stirs the food with a spatula, and shakes the pan to ensure the mushrooms cook evenly.
